# Creative Generation
1. Identify the current winning ad's hook, angle, format, and offer.
2. Generate 3 variations changing ONE variable each (hook, visual format, or social proof) — never all at once.
3. For each, write the primary text, headline, and a shot-list / image brief.
4. Map each variant to the metric it tests (CTR vs hook, CVR vs offer).
5. Output as a creative-test brief; propose launching as a 4-way ABO test at minimum viable budget.
